workflow: One independently prompted transparent PNG per character. Original generated PNGs are copied unchanged. Rendering samples and fits them at runtime; prompts describe artistic intent rather than verified exact palette or logical resolution.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production transparent PNG sprite for BOSSRUSH, an original Android fantasy boss-battle game. Create exactly ONE isolated FULL-BODY character, no others, no sheet, no panels, NO TEXT, no logo, no ground, no backdrop, genuinely transparent alpha everywhere outside the character, transparent spaces between limbs. Style: exquisitely detailed hand-placed Japanese 16-bit RPG enemy pixel art, ornate Romancing SaGa-era monster sprite craftsmanship, NOT vector, NOT blocky childish/chibi shape art, NOT smooth painting. Work as a 160 by 160 logical pixel sprite, enlarged with exact nearest-neighbor square pixel clusters. Rich deliberate clusters and stepped contours, sharp rim lighting, deep shadows, selectively stippled transitions. Palette: strictly MONOCHROME SAGE GREEN, dark green-black shadows #101d1a, moss midtones #6f8a5b, pale yellow-green highlights #d8e7a8; 8 to 12 coherent green shades, NO blue, red or other colored hues. Three-quarter battle pose facing slightly toward lower left, elegant imposing silhouette, face and equipment readable at thumbnail scale. Fully contained with at least 8% transparent padding on ALL sides, no cropped weapons/wings/horns/feet, lower feet near bottom center. The supplied subject is a Norse mythology adaptation, original design; do not reproduce any existing game character. IMPORTANT: no glow or haze outside the character. Square canvas, complete silhouette with 12% transparent margins.
